meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查本地安装的 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI，对比最新源码，生成一份通过/警告/失败的诊断报告，每个结论都附上具体证据。它不会修改你的安装。
howto.when: 当你问“医生”或“健康检查”，提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex 等关键词，或安装、更新、配置后 Codex 行为异常、怀疑安装过时或损坏时自动触发。

say.text: 检查一下我的 LazyCodex 安装是否健康。
say.note: Claude 会运行诊断并给出报告。

say.text: 诊断 Codex CLI 的当前配置。
say.note: Claude 会检查配置文件和插件完整性。

say.text: 对比最新源码审计本地安装。
say.note: Claude 会同步最新源并对比差异。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will inspect the local LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation, compare it against the latest sources, and produce a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence for each verdict. It never modifies your installation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention keywords like 'LazyCodex', 'lazycodex-ai', 'omo-codex', or after install/update/config change where Codex behaves oddly, or when you suspect a stale/drifted/broken setup.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex install is healthy.
say_en.note: Claude will run diagnostics and output a report.
Claude will verify config files and plugin integrity.

say_en.text: Audit my local install against the latest source.
say_en.note: Claude will sync the latest source and compare differences.
